design_philosophy: Warm, aspirational, premium-yet-approachable. Leveraging generous spacing, editorial typography, and high-quality photography to build trust with middle-income families in Mumbai. No blues, no techy gradients.

typography.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none font-bold text-[#1C2B3A]
typography.h2: text-3xl sm:text-4xl tracking-tight leading-tight font-bold text-[#1C2B3A]
typography.label: text-sm tracking-[0.15em] uppercase font-semibold text-[#C17453]

spacing_and_layout.section_padding: py-20 md:py-32 px-6 md:px-12 max-w-7xl mx-auto
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Mobile-first approach. Optical alignment for text and icons. Generous negative space between sections.

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1) with soft ambient shadow increase (shadow-lg). Buttons shift background colors gracefully with 300ms transitions.
motion_and_interaction.entrance_animations: Staggered fade-up (opacity 0 to 1, y: 20 to 0) for lists and grids using framer-motion.
motion_and_interaction.hero_parallax: Hero background image scales slightly (1 to 1.05) on load or scroll, adding a premium cinematic feel.

hero.layout: Full screen (min-h-[90vh]) with absolute background image. Content aligned left or center-left.
hero.overlay: Gradient overlay for text legibility: bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1C2B3A]/80 via-[#1C2B3A]/40 to-transparent.
hero.ctas: Primary CTA 'Get Free Quote' uses Terracotta (#C17453). Secondary CTA 'WhatsApp' uses outline or soft white with Terracotta text.

services_grid.layout: Asymmetrical Bento Grid. E.g., Kitchen (col-span-8), Wardrobes (col-span-4), etc.
services_grid.style: Cards use #FFFFFF background, subtle border, and soft shadow. Icons in Terracotta or Soft Gold.
services_grid.tags: One-liner benefits styled as subtle badges or distinct body text.

why_us.style: Background section in tinted color (#F3EFE9). Big numbers in #C17453.

gallery.layout: Grid of 6 images (grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6).
gallery.style: Images fill containers. Hover reveals a sleek overlay with 'Service - Locality' label in #FFFFFF.

testimonials.layout: 3 columns on desktop, horizontal scroll or stack on mobile.
testimonials.style: Solid white cards, max 8px radius. Soft Gold (#D4AF37) for star ratings.

quote_form.layout: Two-column layout: Left (Trust markers + Contact Info), Right (Form Card).
quote_form.style: Shadcn UI customized. Inputs have soft backgrounds (#F3EFE9) and no harsh black borders. Focus ring is #C17453/50.

whatsapp_floating.style: Circular or pill shape. Uses WhatsApp green (#25D366) or Terracotta depending on visual balance, but standard green usually converts best for WA.

hero.description: Warm modern living room for hero section background.

testing_attributes.rules: All interactive elements, buttons, form inputs, and major sections MUST include data-testid. Examples: data-testid='hero-quote-btn', data-testid='quote-form-submit'.

libraries_and_packages.icons: lucide-react (default) or @phosphor-icons/react for premium line-art feel.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Background should primarily be #FAF7F2.
Do NOT use default Inter font for headings. Use an editorial serif like Playfair Display or Cormorant Garamond.
Use custom Shadcn UI for the form, do not use native HTML selects/inputs.
Ensure the hero section background image overlay does not completely kill the image (max opacity 0.5 or use gradient from left).
Include a sticky WhatsApp button for mobile and desktop.
